sentences.text:
The case was heard on 12.09.2022 and the Court has passed the following order:-
"
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.
Perused the record.

This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been preferred seeking the quashing of the entire proceeding of Case No.1217 of 2021 arising out of Case Crime No.240 of 2021 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 DP Act, P.S.-Link Road,
District-Ghaziabad as well as charge-sheet dated 23.8.2021 pending in the court of ACJ (JD)-V, Ghaziabad.
The submission of learned counsel for the applicants is that through good offices of certain well-meaning persons the parties have amicably settled the dispute among themselves and have mutually compromised in the matter.
According to the counsel there is no dispute left out any more in between the parties and they wish no more litigation in between them.

The contention of the counsel for the applicants is that as the opp. party no.2 is not interested to pursue the matter pending in the lower court and is not inclined to give any evidence against the accused, the acquittal of the accused-applicants is now a foregone conclusion.
It shall be a sheer abuse of the court's process, if the proceedings going on in the lower court are still allowed to go on further.
Submission therefore is that in the wake of the inter-se compromise arrived at in between the parties, the impugned proceedings ought to be quashed.

Let compromise, if any, be filed before trial court, where it shall be verified in presence of both sides and after its verification, certified copy of compromise along with verification order of trial court concerned, be filed on record of this Court, by way of supplementary affidavit.
List this case on 15.11.2022 before the appropriate Bench.

Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the above mentioned case. "
4.

Pursuant to order dated 12.09.2022, compromise has been verified by Additional Civil Judge(J.D.)/Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 5, Ghaziabad vide order dated 03.01.2023 and the same has been annexed in the supplementary affidavit.

entities.text: Additional Civil Judge(J.D.)/Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 5, Ghaziabad
entities.label: COURT

5. Learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2 he has not objected the aforesaid facts and submitted that in case proceedings against the applicants is quashed, she would have no objection.
6.
In view of the facts and circumstances of the case, the applicants and opposite party no. 2 do not want to pursue the case any further as stated by them.
